papers.title_en: Hosting Capacity Assessment and Enhancement for Edge Data Centers in Active Distribution Networks
papers.evidence: 边缘数据中心在配电网中的接入容量评估，涉及电网和数据中心
papers.tldr: 边缘数据中心接入主动配电网的需求日益增长，但受限于网络拓扑与电气距离，不同母线的主机容量差异显著。本文识别了电流、电压及混合约束三种限制机制，并评估了BESS、DDG和STATCOM等柔性资源。结果表明，这些资源通过有功支撑、本地发电和无功补偿互补地扩展了主机容量，为数据中心选址与规划提供了指导。
papers.abstract_en: With the increasing demand for edge computing and AI-driven workloads, integrating small and medium-sized edge data centers into distribution networks has become increasingly important. This paper investigates the hosting capacity of distribution networks for data center integration and identifies the key physical mechanisms that limit the maximum allowable data center load. The baseline analysis shows that data center hosting capacity varies significantly across candidate buses due to network topology and electrical distance. Three dominant limiting mechanisms are identified: current-constrained locations, voltage-constrained locations, and mixed-constrained locations where both current loading and voltage deviation jointly affect hosting capacity. To increase the hosting capacity, this study evaluates multiple flexible resources, including battery energy storage systems (BESS), dispatchable distributed generators (DDG), and static synchronous compensators (STATCOM). Numerical results demonstrate that these resources provide complementary benefits through active power support, sustained local generation, and reactive power compensation, effectively expanding data center hosting capacity in distribution systems.
